remarks: Nestled within the Putnam Park community in the heart Greenwich, this sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom co-op offers effortless, single-level living in a serene, park-like setting. Spanning over 1,200 square feet, the residence features three exposures, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. The open floor plan creates a seamless flow between living and dining spaces, complemented by an updated kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances--ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms add a modern touch, while an oversized in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience. Step outside to a private bluestone terrace--perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.
